collection.title: Alfa Romeo Mito 2008 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Alfa Romeo Mito 2008 - 2018 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
